create_LRMGenerator: create an LRMGenerator model with camera embed dim, transformer dims, and triplane resolution parameters
create_CameraEmbedder: create a CameraEmbedder that maps raw camera features to a high-dimensional embedding vector
build_LRMGenerator_forward: build a forward pass through LRMGenerator that encodes images, embeds cameras, and generates triplane outputs
test_LRMGenerator_forward: test the LRMGenerator forward method with matching batch-size image and camera tensors
review_CameraEmbedder_forward: review the CameraEmbedder forward method that applies a two-layer SiLU MLP to camera feature vectors
